# madebyjustas.dev

> "I can make your Pinterest dreams come true." Justas Aksamitauskas is an independent web developer with a software engineering background. He designs and hand-codes fast, beautiful websites for service businesses (med spas, aesthetics, legal, hospitality, wellness) and makes sure they get found on Google and in AI search tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. 64+ websites shipped.

The whole site is a single page: https://madebyjustas.dev/

## Sections

- [Work](https://madebyjustas.dev/#work): Six recent projects with live links: Aksendo (artist editorial site), 21-Day Reset (CRO landing), Decks&Stories (global music platform), Tvorteka (fence and gate maker), Blumu (app marketing site), Elesen Show 2026 (event microsite).
- [Pinterest](https://madebyjustas.dev/#pinterest): Send the pins you love and Justas builds a site in that spirit, made for your business, in 1–2 weeks.
- [Services](https://madebyjustas.dev/#services): New Build, Audit & Optimize, Maintenance, plus FAQ.
- [About](https://madebyjustas.dev/#about): Who Justas is and how he works.
- [Contact](https://madebyjustas.dev/#contact): Project enquiry form, including a free website audit.

## Services

- **New Build**: Discovery call, a design system for the brand, a hand-coded fast build, schema and AI-search foundations, two rounds of revisions, 30 days of support. Usually 1–2 weeks.
- **Audit & Optimize**: Five-part audit (speed, SEO, AI search, UX, trust), a prioritised action list, speed and structured-data fixes. A week at most.
- **Maintenance**: Monthly performance and AI-search report, up to 8 hours of updates a month, priority replies.

Pricing: a fixed quote after a short discovery call.

## How it works

1. Send your pins or a few sites you like.
2. Justas designs and hand-codes the site, served from Cloudflare's global edge network.
3. It launches in 1–2 weeks with structured data, a real FAQ and local SEO from day one.
